rules.name: Temporal, Rate-Limiting & Financial Arithmetic
rules.description: Multi-step time window, rate limit, reserve, and financial calculations require chain-of-thought verification

conditions.regex_match: \b(sliding window|rate limit|quota|depreciation|required reserves|compound interest|elapsed time|business days|calendar days|rescheduled to|between what times)\b

rules.name: Probabilistic & Statistical Reasoning
rules.description: Bayesian posteriors, combinatorics, and calibrated probability distributions require explicit derivation

conditions.regex_match: \b(Give probabilities|conditional probability|Bayes|false-positive rate|base rate|drawn without replacement|expected value|standard deviation)\b

rules.name: Nested Boolean & Symbolic Logic
rules.description: Boolean negations, truth tables, and formal syllogisms cannot be resolved by vector similarity

rules.name: Scientific & Reaction Balancing
rules.description: Stoichiometric equations, redox balancing, and chemical half-reactions require discrete derivation

rules.name: API Schema & Parameter Verification
rules.description: Function call parameters, tool signatures, and missing argument checks require exact token parsing

conditions.regex_match: \b(missing argument|required parameter|tool signature|function definition|schema validation|Available tools:)\b

rules.name: Hierarchical Legal & Policy Override
rules.description: Long documents with conflicting clauses or endorsements dilute embedding centroids

rules.name: Deterministic Account Actions
rules.description: Bypass Tier 0 for short account commands
